subject: DPA + SCCs: alignment request and proposed order form changes
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@acmehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: David Cole <david.cole@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -0500
Subject: Initial DPA redlines / SCCs mapping for review

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal reviewed the MSA + order form and attached a set of suggested changes to the Data Processing Addendum and the SCCs exhibit. Key asks from our side:

- Clarify controller/processor roles in Section 2 to reflect that Acme will remain controller for patient data.
- Add a 30-day notice and mitigation clause for cross-border transfer exceptions.
- Confirm that Redwood can support VPC-only private deployment; add explicit language in Order Form hosting section.
- Request higher retention for audit logs (12 months) as evidence for our compliance team.

I've attached Acme_DPA_redlines_initial.docx and SCCs_mapping_acme.xlsx. Can you confirm which items are likely to be accepted vs items that need escalation to Privacy/Product? We have a procurement cutover target of Dec 22 and would prefer to get final redlines and any suggested alternate language by the 14th so our GC can review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Legal Ops
Acme Health

Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines / SCCs mapping for review

Elena —

Thanks for sending these over and for the clear priorities. We can take this on; looping in Ben (contracts) and Laura (privacy) to triage. Quick notes from a first read:

- Controller/processor language: we already have typical language but we'll propose a tightened definition to explicitly name the datasets that are controller-managed. Likely straightforward.
- 30-day notice + mitigation for transfer exceptions: will need product/infra confirmation for fallback paths; flagging as a potential Order Form addendum or transfer addendum.
- VPC-only private deployment: commercial/ops OK for dedicated/private, but we need to confirm hosting SLA and explicit hosting clause in the Order Form (Ben).
- Audit logs retention: we can offer 12 months for audit log exports as a paid option; need to call out format and delivery cadence.

Laura — can you review the SCCs mapping and confirm if the proposed technical safeguards meet our standard response? Ben — can you draft a minimal Order Form carve that captures VPC-only hosting and a transfer addendum option so we can present alternate wording to Acme?

We aim to return consolidated redlines + a short comment matrix by EOD Monday (14 Dec). If anything is blocked earlier we'll flag.

Jonas
VP, Legal Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines / SCCs mapping for review

Ben/Laura —

Internal triage notes and action items (short sprint):

1) Controller/Processor definition — Laura: propose explicit definition text that enumerates the categories of Acme patient data (PHI-lite classification we use) and a single sentence that disclaims processing activities that Redwood performs strictly as a processor. Target: draft text by Mon 12:00 PT.

2) Transfer exceptions & 30-day mitigation — Ben: draft an Order Form transfer addendum template with 2 options: (A) Acme accepts standard SCCs + documented fallback region (EU) + customer-notify flow; (B) customer purchases transfer-addendum with 30-day notification + mitigation plan including temporary local caching and customer-controlled keys. Include pricing delta for option B. Target: draft by Mon EOB.

3) VPC-only hosting language — Ben: draft minimal clause to add to Order Form "Hosting and Isolation" section that names the VPC/private deployment SKU and high-level SLA and data residency commitment. Include operational handshake (contact, runbook) as an exhibit.

4) Audit log retention — Laura: confirm whether 12-month export is feasible and whether we need a paid upgrade. If feasible, produce a carriage/cadence clause (daily/weekly exports) + evidence format (CSV/JSON).

5) Technical safeguards (SCCs mapping) — Laura: review SCCs_mapping_acme.xlsx and annotate rows that require encryption-of-in-transit vs at-rest clarifications and any HSM/KMS references.

We will assemble a consolidated redline file and a one-page comment matrix for Acme. Plan to ship Monday morning PT to allow Acme GC review the 14th. If any item is a hard no, call it out clearly so we can escalate.

Thanks — Jonas

Elena —

Appreciate the patience. Attached is a consolidated package: Redlines_consolidated_jonas_20261214.docx and an internal comment matrix mapping Acme asks to proposed language and our rationale. Summary of the outcome and proposed next steps below.

Summary highlights (short):
- Controller/Processor: proposed tightened language in Section 2 that explicitly lists the Acme-managed data categories. We mark this as accepted without change.
- Transfer exceptions / 30-day mitigation: we propose an Order Form Transfer Addendum (Option A: "Standard Transfer Path") that documents default EU-hosting fallback and a 7-day emergency flow; Option B ("Enhanced Transfer Addendum") includes the 30-day notice + mitigation playbook and an optional temporary local cache + customer-controlled keys. Option B is a paid add-on.
- VPC-only hosting: we added a minimal "Hosting and Isolation" exhibit that names the VPC SKU and points to an operational runbook. Order Form language includes the hosting SKU and a reference to the runbook URL.
- Audit logs: we can provide 12-month audit log exports; delivery will be weekly CSV exports to a customer S3 bucket. This will be included as an optional billing SKU (pricing note in the matrix).
- SCCs mapping: Laura annotated the SCCs_mapping_acme.xlsx — where we needed stronger KMS language we proposed explicit references to our KMS integration and key-rotation cadence.

Next steps / timeline:
1) Please review the consolidated redlines attached and let us know which Option (A or B) you prefer for transfer addendum.
2) If Option B, procurement should confirm SOW/pricing and we can generate an Order Form amendment.
3) We can route final redlines to DocuSign by Dec 20 if we get sign-off by EOD Dec 17.

Meeting: If helpful, Ben and Laura are available for a 30-min sync this week. Proposed time: Thu 17 Dec 10:00–10:30 PT.

DocuSign link (prepped draft): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/EXAMPLE-DOCUSIGN-ACME-4521
Drive folder with attachments and comment matrix: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aH-ExampleDriveLink

If you'd like, we'll attach a one-page "decision matrix" to the order form that makes Option A vs B tradeoffs explicit for your procurement team.

Thanks and speak soon,

Jonas Weber
